title: Similar monthly payments between the same accounts
rationale: Check whether defense uses facts to support an alternative interpretation and whether prosecution remains proportionate. Regularity does not prove legitimacy.

prosecution: Recognize the alert as a review signal and the absence of a clear suspicious pattern in the supplied rows.
State that the payment purpose remains unconfirmed without inventing grounds for accusation.
defense: Identify three payments of 1200 USD between the same accounts on the eighth day of consecutive months, citing amounts, accounts and dates.
Present a recurring payment as a possible interpretation without asserting that it is rent, salary or an invoice.
forbidden: Declare innocence or conclude that the alert is definitely a false positive.
Invent contracts, salaries, invoices or an explanation for the score.
Use regularity as proof of legitimacy.
limitations: The payment purpose and relationship between account holders were not supplied.
Earlier dates represent fictional history for agent review, not a test of model data splits.
